issues.explanation: The first adaptation says孔明“率军返回成都,” implying he has already reached Chengdu, but the next chapter begins with him退回汉中 and only then回成都. Both source chapters establish that chapter 100 ends with孔明 heading toward成都, while chapter 101 specifies the intermediate retreat to汉中 before his arrival.
issues.suggested_fix: Change the chapter-100 ending to “孔明率军向成都方向撤退” or “退回汉中后再赴成都,” preserving the intermediate stop described at the start of chapter 101.
